WITH team_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    AVG(CAST(w AS FLOAT)) as W,
    AVG(CASE WHEN l IS NOT NULL AND l > 0 THEN CAST(g - l AS FLOAT) / CAST(l AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END) as Q
  FROM manager_half
  GROUP BY team_id
  HAVING AVG(CAST(w AS FLOAT)) IS NOT NULL
),
T_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(W) as T FROM team_stats WHERE W IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  team_stats.team_id,
  ROUND(team_stats.W, 4) as W,
  ROUND(team_stats.Q, 4) as Q,
  ROUND(team_stats.W - T_value.T, 4) as W_minus_T
FROM team_stats
CROSS JOIN T_value
WHERE T_value.T IS NOT NULL AND team_stats.W > T_value.T
ORDER BY W_minus_T DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH joined AS (
  SELECT ili.*, p.product_color
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  INNER JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    product_color,
    COUNT(*) as N
  FROM joined
  WHERE product_color IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY product_color
),
with_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    product_color,
    N,
    (SELECT SUM(N) FROM grouped) as T
  FROM grouped
),
with_share AS (
  SELECT 
    product_color,
    N,
    T,
    CAST(N AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / T as share
  FROM with_totals
  WHERE T IS NOT NULL
),
avg_n AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(N AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as M
  FROM with_share
),
with_m AS (
  SELECT 
    ws.product_color,
    ws.N,
    ws.share,
    an.M
  FROM with_share ws
  CROSS JOIN avg_n an
  WHERE an.M IS NOT NULL
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    product_color,
    N,
    share,
    M,
    CAST(N AS DECIMAL(19,4)) - M as D
  FROM with_m
  WHERE N > M
)
SELECT 
  AVG(CAST(N AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_n,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(D) as avg_d
FROM filtered

SELECT 
    ili.order_item_id,
    p.product_color,
    AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS FLOAT)) as avg_units,
    AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / ili.derived_total_cost) as avg_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.product_color ORDER BY AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS FLOAT)) DESC) as rank
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  INNER JOIN Order_Items oi ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  INNER JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color
  HAVING RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.product_color ORDER BY AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS FLOAT)) DESC) <= 3
  ORDER BY p.product_color, rank

WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    ili.order_item_id,
    c.town_city,
    AVG(ili.product_price) as avg_price,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ili.derived_total_cost > 0 
            THEN ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost 
            ELSE NULL END) as ratio_avg
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  INNER JOIN Order_Items oi ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  INNER JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  INNER JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    town_city,
    AVG(avg_price) as P,
    AVG(ratio_avg) as avg_ratio
  FROM step1
  GROUP BY town_city
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT AVG(P) as Q FROM step2
)
SELECT 
  s2.town_city,
  s2.P,
  s2.avg_ratio,
  s2.P - s3.Q as P_minus_Q
FROM step2 s2
CROSS JOIN step3 s3
WHERE s2.P > s3.Q
ORDER BY s2.town_city

),
total_count AS (

),
with_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    pg.product_type_description,
    pg.group_count,
    CAST(pg.group_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / tc.S as R
  FROM product_groups pg
  CROSS JOIN total_count tc
),
avg_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(R) as M FROM with_ratios
)
SELECT 
  wr.product_type_description,
  wr.group_count,
  wr.R,
  wr.R - ar.M as R_minus_M
FROM with_ratios wr
CROSS JOIN avg_ratio ar
WHERE wr.R > ar.M
ORDER BY wr.product_type_description

WITH joined AS (
  SELECT 
    il.InvoiceId,
    c.State,
    COUNT(*) as N
  FROM InvoiceLine il
  INNER JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
  INNER JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  GROUP BY il.InvoiceId, c.State
),
state_sums AS (
  SELECT 
    State,
    SUM(N) as state_total
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY State
),
with_d AS (
  SELECT 
    j.InvoiceId,
    j.State,
    j.N,
    CAST(j.N AS FLOAT) / ss.state_total as D,
    ss.state_total
  FROM joined j
  INNER JOIN state_sums ss ON j.State = ss.State
),
state_avg_d AS (
  SELECT 
    State,
    AVG(D) as avg_D

),
with_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    wd.InvoiceId,

    wd.N,

WITH manager_counts AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) as count FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ReportsTo), total_emp AS (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) as total FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL), shares AS (SELECT ReportsTo, count, CAST(count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total FROM total_emp) as share FROM manager_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares) SELECT ReportsTo, count, share, (share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share)) as diff FROM shares INNER JOIN avg_share ON 1=1 ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH pair_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN CAST(t.amount AS REAL)
      WHEN t.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN -CAST(t.amount AS REAL)
    END) as M
  FROM account a
  INNER JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ', 'VYBER')
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency
),
freq_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    frequency,
    AVG(M) as F
  FROM pair_stats
  GROUP BY frequency
)
SELECT 
  p.account_id,
  p.frequency,
  p.M,
  p.M / f.F as ratio
FROM pair_stats p
INNER JOIN freq_stats f ON p.frequency = f.frequency
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN p.M / f.F IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  p.M / f.F DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH account_region_trans AS (

      WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
      WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
    END as signed_amount,
    t.balance
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id

  WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
),
account_region_stats AS (
  SELECT

  GROUP BY account_id, region
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    AVG(M) as RM,
    AVG(B) as RB
  FROM account_region_stats

),
global_avg AS (

  FROM region_stats

SELECT
  rs.region,
  rs.RM,
  rs.RB,
  rs.RM / ga.G as ratio
FROM region_stats rs

WITH patient_stats AS (

    p.ID,
    p.SEX,

),
